policy: Digest-pin only. Raw corpus bytes and gold are licensed/derived and are NOT committed (see .gitignore). Re-download from the pinned revision, verify sha256, then rebuild via scripts/build_and_audit.py.
acquisition_note: All sources no-auth/200 from the run host. Gated HF datasets (LEDGAR, CaseHOLD, PhraseBank mirrors) returned HTTP 401 without consent and are excluded by policy, not silently substituted.

arxiv_cs.acquisition: Atom feed, summary field, sortBy=submittedDate descending, live at fetch time
arxiv_cs.revision_note: arXiv is not immutable-pinnable; frozen by local sha256 of fetched rows

arxiv_stem.upstream: arXiv API search_query=cat:physics.* OR cat:q-bio.* OR cat:math.* OR cat:stat.*
arxiv_stem.acquisition: Atom feed, summary field, live at fetch time
arxiv_stem.revision_note: not immutable-pinnable; frozen by local sha256

pubmed.acquisition: abstract text blocks, live at fetch time
pubmed.revision_note: PMID list captured in local_data; not immutable-pinnable

fiqa.acquisition: corpus/corpus-00000-of-00001.parquet (in-tree parquet; datasets-server rows 404s for this repo)
fiqa.license: FiQA subset terms; redistribute as derived snippets only

courtlistener.acquisition: opinions[].snippet / syllabus, live at fetch time
courtlistener.revision_note: not immutable-pinnable; frozen by local sha256
courtlistener.low_yield_note: only 44 usable snippets (most result bodies unhighlighted); EUR-Lex carries legal train volume

eurlex.upstream: EUR-Lex CELEX TXT pages (public EU law, reusable)
eurlex.acquisition: Article-chunked text from live CELEX pages at fetch time
eurlex.revision_note: CELEX ids pinned per act; page bytes not immutable-pinnable

20ng_comp.acquisition: datasets-server rows split=test, label_text prefix comp.
20ng_comp.gold_semantics: independent topical label (newsgroup name), NOT source membership
20ng_comp.known_limitation: 20newsgroups is memorization-prone; audit fingerprints/name/gold and prune leaked rows; ceiling risk documented

20ng_sci.acquisition: datasets-server rows split=test, label_text prefix sci.

agnews_biz.license: derived from aggregated news; pin only, no redistribution

legislation_uk.acquisition: section/para chunks from live act XML at fetch time
legislation_uk.revision_note: acts version-pinned via data.xml at fetch time
